name: autogluon.tabular
description: AutoGluon Tabular automates ML model training for tabular data, excelling at numerical and categorical data processing. It doesn't support NLP or image-based tasks.
prompt_template: Pick a `presets` value appropriate to the dataset size and available compute, and follow any preset or compute budget stated in the task description if one is given. Note the heaviest presets require a GPU plus extra foundation-model dependencies and can silently degrade to a trivial model when those are absent.

Do not manually split a validation set from the training data - AutoGluon Tabular automatically handles internal validation and reports validation scores, so simply pass the full training data to the fit() method.

AutoGluon Tabular requires converting multiple label columns into either a single combined label for mutually exclusive cases or training separate predictors for each label in non-exclusive scenarios.
